name: live station discovery
sql: SELECT CAST(count(*)>100 AS INTEGER) FROM tides.main.stations()

name: live tide predictions
sql: SELECT CAST(count(*)>0 AND count(height_m)=count(*) AS INTEGER) FROM tides.main.tide_predictions('8518750',CAST(current_date AS VARCHAR),CAST(current_date AS VARCHAR))

name: live observed water levels
sql: SELECT CAST(count(*)>0 AS INTEGER) FROM tides.main.water_levels('8518750',CAST(current_date-1 AS VARCHAR),CAST(current_date-1 AS VARCHAR))

name: live current predictions
sql: SELECT CAST(count(*)>0 AND count(velocity_major_mps)=count(*) AS INTEGER) FROM tides.main.current_predictions('ACT0956',CAST(current_date AS VARCHAR),CAST(current_date AS VARCHAR))

name: live current bins
sql: SELECT CAST(count(*)>0 AND count(bin)=count(*) AND count(depth_m)=count(*) AS INTEGER) FROM tides.main.current_bins('cb0102')

name: live NOAA historical current observations
sql: SELECT CAST(count(*)>0 AND count(speed_mps)=count(*) AS INTEGER) FROM tides.main.currents('cb0102','2025-11-12','2025-11-12',bin := 4)
